description_sq:
Disponojmë Vilë 3-katëshe për Shitje.
Vila është i pozicionuar në zonën e TEG-ut, Kompleksi CUCI
Vilat me sipërfaqe 359.3 m2, shtrihen në 2 kate mbi toke plus një kat nëntokë, tarracë të gjelbëruar 100 m2, oborr të gjelbëruar 600 m2. Kati nëntokë, ajroset dhe ndricohet nga drita natyrale, e siguruar nga hapsira e tunelit 40 m2. Gjelbërimi i oborrit, verandave, dhe tarracës është projektuar nga studio e njohur Italiane Sandrini.
1 VILË DISPONON:
• 600m2 sipërfaqe trualli për vile përfshirë edhe njollën e ndërtimit.
• 640 m2 ndërtim përfshirë dhe sipërfaqe verande ose tarracë.
• E organizuar ne 4 ambjente.
Kati -1, kati 0, kati 1 dhe kati i tarraces në total disponon:
1 sallon 
1 ambjent gatimi dhe ambjent ngrënie

Pishinë dhe xhakuzi i përbashket për të rritur dhe femijë

Ambjent shum i përshtatshem për qëndrim pushim dhe barbeque.
BOSH
• Në vend të mureve të jashtme tradicional me tulla, është përdorur System + me mure polisteroli EPS 16 dhe 18 cm, me rrjeta celiku të galvanizuara, që sigurojnë një eficencë maksimale termike si dhe një koeficent të lartë sigurie ndaj lekundjeve sizmike.
• Muret e brendeshme, janë realizuar me dopio panele gipsi me mbushje pambuku mineral 10cm, duke ofruar izolimin akustik të nevojshëm.
• Sistemet kondicionimit me Chiller Daikin Inverter, sigurojnë efikasitet të lartë edhe në ngarkesat e pjeseshme. Altherma RHW për ujin sanitar e kombinuar me panelet diellore garantojnë eficencën e nevojshme për ruajtjen e tij. Ngrohja elektrike nga dyshemeja me rezistencat tubolare Raychem, në ambjentet e tualeteve ruan temperaturat e nevojshme ne dimër.
• Vetratat e aluminit të serisë Exalco Albio 235 dhe Exalco Albio 109C me xhama dypleks Guardian glass, me rrëshqitje, bioklimatike, karakterizohen nga luksi në dizajn. Profilet me forcë të lartë janë ideale për hapje të mëdha, si dhe sigurojnë performancë të lartë në izolimin termik e akustik.
• Vila është pajisura me sinjal tokësor dhe satelitor. Sistemi mundëson kapjen e sinjalit nga dy satelite të ndryshëm njëkohësisht. Antena e sinjalit tokesor eleminon deformimin e sinjalit televiziv nga interferencë të tjera.
Interneti (Wi-Fi) mbulon të gjithë sipërfaqjen e vilës dhe shpërndahet me antena tavanore me dizenjim modern për cdo kat. Antenat shpërndajnë sinjal nëpermjet valeve 2,4/5 Gliz.
• Vila ka të instaluar sisteme të sigurisë së lartë me akses dhe kontrol. Hyrja në vile mundësohet nëpërmjet teknologjisë RFID me anë të kartave të personalizuara.
• Ndicim bashkohor, i realizuar me ndricues “LED” të markave Philips dhe Ideal Lux.
• Vila është e shtruar me parket druri inxhinjerik.
Ndodhet në një zonë të aksesueshme dhe të preferuar për banim.
Për ta vizituar na kontaktoni.
description_en: We have a 3-storey villa for sale. The villa is located in the area of ​​TEG, Complex CUCI Villas with an area of ​​359.3 m2, spread over 2 floors above ground plus an underground floor, green terrace 100 m2, green yard 600 m2. The underground floor is ventilated and illuminated by natural light, provided by the 40 m2 tunnel space. The landscaping of the yard, porches, and terrace was designed by the well-known Italian studio Sandrini. 1 VILLA AVAILABLE: • 600m2 plot area for the villa including the construction area. • 640 m2 of construction including veranda or terrace area. • Organized in 4 areas. Floor -1, floor 0, floor 1 and the terrace floor in total have: 1 living room 1 kitchen area and dining area 1 studio 4 bedrooms 5 bathrooms 1 balcony 1 laundry room 1 space suitable for cinema, gym, etc. Spacious terraces and verandas Usable green space (courtyard) 2 parking spaces Shared swimming pool and jacuzzi for adults and children Central Daikin air conditioning system. Fireplace in the living room that distributes the heat to the 2 floors of the villa. Super quality in construction and furnishing. Floor -1 (162.4m2) Has 1 bedroom 1 laundry room 1 studio 1 toilet Space for cinema, gym, etc. Floor 0 (158.5m2) Has living room Kitchen area Dining area 1 toilet 1 veranda Floor 1 (192.7 m2) Has 3 bedrooms 3 toilets 1 balcony 1 green veranda First floor terrace (125.1m2) Very suitable environment for rest and barbeque. BLANK • Instead of traditional external brick walls, System + with 16 and 18 cm EPS polystyrene walls, with galvanized steel grids, which ensure maximum thermal efficiency and a high safety coefficient against seismic shaking, is used. • The internal walls are made with double gypsum panels with 10cm mineral cotton filling, providing the necessary acoustic insulation. • Air conditioning systems with Daikin Inverter Chiller ensure high efficiency even in partial loads. Altherma RHW for sanitary water combined with solar panels guarantee the necessary efficiency for its storage. Electric heating from the floor with Raychem tubular resistances, in the toilets, maintains the necessary temperatures in winter. • Aluminum windows of the Exalco Albio 235 and Exalco Albio 109C series with duplex Guardian glass, sliding, bioclimatic, are characterized by luxury in design. High-strength profiles are ideal for large openings, as well as ensuring high performance in thermal and acoustic insulation. • The villa is equipped with terrestrial and satellite signal. The system enables capturing the signal from two different satellites simultaneously. The terrestrial signal antenna eliminates the distortion of the television signal by other interference. Internet (Wi-Fi) covers the entire surface of the villa and is distributed with ceiling antennas of modern design for each floor. Antennas distribute signal through 2.4/5 Gliz waves. • The villa has installed high security systems with access and control. Entry to the villas is made possible through RFID technology by means of personalized cards. • Simultaneous lighting, realized with "LED" lamps of Philips and Ideal Lux brands. • The villa is laid with engineered wood parquet. It is located in an accessible and preferred residential area. To visit it, contact us.
